state.query: evidence that rain caused fewer insects

candidates.title: Rain reduced pollinator activity
candidates.body: Speculative causal explanation, not established by the interrupted visit or the two rows. Distinguish missing observations from fewer insects.

candidates.title: Did rain affect activity or observation?
candidates.body:
# Open question
Did rain change pollinator activity or only prevent observation? Current notes do not resolve this causal question.

candidates.title: Why the sampling plan changed
candidates.body:
# Controlled study reasoning
2024-05-18T09:00:00Z Maya proposes noon-only visits.
2024-05-19T11:00:00Z Rain interrupts the noon visit.
2024-05-20T08:00:00Z Maya adopts morning and noon observations. No accuracy comparison was run.

candidates.title: Two pollinator counts
candidates.body: Controlled rows: 17 May 2024, Maya, Riverside, 12 visits, 10 minutes; 18 May, 8 visits, 10 minutes. Rows do not attribute a difference to rain.

candidates.title: Sampling homework
candidates.body: Controlled homework: 12 visits in ten minutes is 1.2 per minute. A short observation does not estimate all-day activity. Rain causality is not established.
